review_comment: The code performs a time-of-check (fs.lstat) followed by a time-of-use decision based on mtime comparison, creating a TOCTOU race condition. The 'this.newer' flag enables this behavior, and without synchronization, an attacker can manipulate file states between check and use. Add atomic operations or file locking to prevent the race condition.
